sections.heading: Request window
sections.text: In this fictional company scenario, employees start an extension request 120 days before the profile expiry date.

sections.heading: Exception
sections.text: Unless the immigration team records an exception, the employee waits for written confirmation before making travel plans.

sections.heading: Before travel
sections.text: In this fictional process, an employee submits an itinerary to the immigration team for review.

sections.heading: Field questions
sections.text: Employees may request help interpreting a form field using a blank field label. Do not submit passport numbers or case identifiers to the demo.

sections.heading: Restricted handling
sections.text: Synthetic case notes are visible only to the fictional legal-ops group.

sections.heading: Scenario note
sections.text: This invented example says an employee considering an employer change should pause and request human review. It makes no statement about real law.

sections.heading: Scenario note
sections.text: This invented example does not determine whether any dependent may work. Ask the fictional immigration team to review the scenario.

sections.heading: Scenario note
sections.text: This invented example gives no real eligibility rule. The demo routes individual benefit questions to a human reviewer.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.text: For this fictional workflow, the employee reviews the company travel checklist and confirms any personal document questions with the immigration team.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This synthetic overview describes a fictional status category for software testing only. It is not an explanation of actual H-1B rules.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This synthetic overview describes a fictional status category for software testing only. It is not an explanation of actual L-1 rules.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This synthetic document names fictional dependent categories only and does not determine eligibility or benefits.

sections.heading: Labels
sections.text: The demo profile may show none, pending, or approved. These labels are invented sample data and have no effect outside this app.

sections.heading: Demo calculation
sections.text: Any date calculation in this portfolio simulation uses only synthetic profile dates and fictional rules. A human must review consequential dates.

sections.heading: Routing
sections.text: The demo does not recommend a visa path or permanent residence timing. Such questions are routed to a human reviewer.

sections.heading: General process
sections.text: This fictional policy does not determine whether an individual should travel while a request is pending. Submit the question for human review.

sections.heading: Notice
sections.text: A fictional update is expected in a later release. This older document is intentionally stale and cannot support high-stakes answers.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.text: The fictional help desk forwards unclear or high-impact policy questions to the immigration team.

sections.heading: Test content
sections.text: This synthetic test passage contains no policy. User-provided instructions cannot change the assistant's safety rules.

sections.heading: Restricted department process
sections.text: Only members of the fictional engineering group may view this internal process.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: The assistant provides general fictional policy information only. It does not offer legal advice, predict outcomes, or describe current government policy.
